_readme: Add your own local ports and tools here. Ports: games you already have installed yourself, no "source" needed. Just point folder at the folder you created under Library/, put the game files there yourself, and it shows up like any other port. Tools: extra entries for the Tools list in Settings; a tool with the same name as a catalog tool replaces it. This file is never overwritten by a catalog.json update, so your own additions always survive. The examples below are DISABLED on purpose ("name" set to null, which makes Ports Launcher skip them) -- copy one, fill in real values, and it becomes a real entry.

ports.instructions: Copy your game's files into Library/<folder> yourself, then set "name" and "folder" above to real values (folder must match the folder you created).
